messages:
olivia: Heads up — after the scheduled API key rotation at 02:00 UTC some prod traffic is getting 401s. Not all customers, looks like a subset on eu-west-1. Seen spike since ~02:05. Anyone else?

devon: saw the alert. can you paste a failing curl + headers (no secrets)?

olivia: repro curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=rwkv-3"
```
response snippet: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized` and body `{"error":"invalid_api_key","hint":"key not found"}`

ashley: quick checks: 1) was the key fully revoked or rotated to a new id? 2) are edge caches still serving old keys? 3) any partial rollout of the new sidecar?

olivia: we rotated with the usual job (ops runbook) and notified customers. ops job logs show success for key-id `k-xyz` -> `k-abc`. but some pods on EU still returning `k-xyz` in env.

mike: could be sidecar env not reloaded. our sidecar reads ENV on start; if deployment didn't restart pods, they keep old key. can you check pod restarts?

olivia: checking now: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=api --field-selector=status.phase=Running` gives list. Last restart times vary. A couple of pods show no restart since yesterday.

devon: that aligns. also check vault-agent/consul-template logs — if the agent failed to fetch the new secret it'll keep the old one.

vault-bot: Vault rotation event: secret path `secret/data/prod/apikeys/k-abc` version 2 created at 2026-03-16T02:00:11Z. replication: eu-west-1 status PENDING (replication lag 21s)

ashley: replication lag could explain subset. if replica not yet applied on eu nodes, edge validators will still see old key as revoked. ops, can we force a vault sync or fall back to KMS unwrap logs?

mike: checking KMS unwraps for requests that failed: logs show decryption attempts for `k-abc` succeeded on control plane, but some eu proxy nodes returned `invalid_kid` from our auth layer.

devon: let's try repro flow from an eu node (ssh into an eu node) to hit local validator and get debug output. if env is stale we should see old key present in `/etc/envvars` or sidecar file.

olivia: ssh'ed into eu pod node -> cat /var/run/sidecar/apikey -> shows `k-xyz`. so the sidecar didn't pick up new secret. sidecar logs show repeated `vault timeout` at 02:00:12 then `using cached secret`

ashley: sounds like race: vault rotation + transient timeout -> sidecar used cached secret -> control plane marked key revoked -> requests from that pod fail. mitigation: restart sidecar or pod (hotfix) and re-run vault pull.

mike: agreed. short-term: restart affected pods in eu-west-1 (rolling). long-term: we need a delta-check: if Vault rotation detected, force pod restart or trigger sidecar reload rather than fallback to cached when KMS unwrap or replication pending.

devon: can we add a guard in auth validator: if key is marked revoked in control plane but pod reports cached key, log a high-priority alert and return 503 with a hint rather than 401? That would reduce customer confusion but still block invalid keys.

olivia: immediate action: restarting 3 affected pods now. will monitor errors.

opsbot: restart issued: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/api -n prod --field-selector=spec.nodeName=eu-west-1` (3 pods).

(30s later)

olivia: after restarts, errors dropped to baseline. customers on eu reported services recovered.

devon: follow-ups: 1) add an item to runbook: when rotating keys, check vault replication status and wait for PENDING->COMPLETED for all regions. 2) change sidecar behavior: prefer re-fetch on rotation events and fail open only after N retries with exponential backoff. 3) instrument drift detection alert when pod env key != control-plane assigned key-id.

ashley: I'll file a follow-up ticket and schedule a small patch for sidecar. also suggest we add an automated post-rotation probe that hits each region's validator within a minute.

olivia: ticket + customer comms done. cc @support-leads for postmortem note. :thumbsup:
